Title: [Submission] Crafting Chamber (master location for recruiting allies)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Crafting Chamber
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Tzimisce
Location.
When a minion you control successfully recruits an ally, you can reduce its cost by X and move that ally to this card, out of play, with X power counters. During your influence phase, remove 1 power counter from that ally. You can pay 1 pool to remove 1 power counter from that card. When they are no power counters on that ally, put it in play. Only 1 ally can be on this card at a time.

Thoughts?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> You turbo out ghouls? This card doesnt help speed, you just get more later.
>
Curiously, it might actually help with the aggressive aspect too. If you draw several War Ghouls at once but don't have sufficient retainers/allies that you want to burn, you can get stuck with a Ghoul or two in your hand for an extra turn or so - so you might want to think more carefully about your ratios, tweak the Ghouls down a bit. Now you have the option of recruiting one for free, postponing its appearance, cycling your hand etc., and it's a more permanent solution than Jake Washington. This might mean you choose to tweak the number of War Ghouls in your deck up slightly, aiding the deck's aggression.
